content: When the J1939 Network Management module needs to send an AddressClaimed ( or CannotClaimAddress ) PG, and the CAN Interface has not yet called J1939Nm_ TxConfirmation for the previous transmission, the J1939 Network Management module shall buffer this PG for later transmission.
